articles.description: Roseburg hit 82 degrees Wednesday, setting a new record high for March 18 and marking the hottest day of 2026 so far in the Umpqua Valley. The previous record for the date was 80 degrees, set in 2024.

articles.description: Douglas County Solid Waste will host a free electronics recycling event April 25 at the Roseburg Transfer Station. Residents and small businesses can drop off old electronics from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. Organizers say the event will help keep harmful e-waste out of landfills.
articles.title: Douglas County to Host Free Household Electronics Recycling Event April 25 in Roseburg

articles.description: Thrive Umpqua will celebrate Volunteer Appreciation Month on April 11 with a community cleanup and volunteer celebration at Stewart Park in Roseburg. The event includes pizza, beverages, raffle prizes, lawn games, and ways to get involved. RSVP required.
articles.title: Thrive Umpqua to Host Volunteer Celebration and Community Cleanup April 11 in Roseburg

articles.author: Joseph Ziegler
articles.description: CASA of Douglas County and B’s Sweet Treats & More will host “A Sweet Day for CASA” on April 1 in Roseburg. The fundraiser features buy 2, get 2 free cupcakes from 2-5 p.m., with 50% of blue cupcake proceeds benefiting local children in care.
articles.title: B’s Sweet Treats & More, CASA team up for April 1 fundraiser in Roseburg
